extDesc.message: Save selected text to the notes of the Atoll island and check it with LanguageTool. Everything runs only when you ask.

cmdNote.message: Save the selection to Atoll notes

popupHint.message: Paste text or select it on the page, then press “Check”.

truncated.message: Only the first part of the text was checked (up to 20,000 characters).

islandOffline.message: The island is not running or does not answer.

islandDisabled.message: The link is off on the island: Settings → Behavior → Browser extension.

islandUnauthorized.message: The key does not match: copy it again in the island's settings.

islandNoKey.message: Enter the key in the extension's settings.

optKeyHelp.message: On the island: Settings → Behavior → “Browser extension”: turn the link on and press “Copy key”, then paste it here.

optServerHelp.message: The public api.languagetool.org by default: the selected text goes there only when you press “Check” (free server limit: 20,000 characters and 20 requests a minute). You can use your own server, e.g. http://localhost:8081.

optNeedPermission.message: The browser must allow access to your own server.

optPrivacy.message: The extension sends nothing on its own: a check or a note happens only when you press a button or a shortcut. Notes go only to the island on this PC.
